title: Lookups reach the right reader
goal: Every lookup route delivers each part where its verdict sends it: a near-miss none split prints its facts, the kb: hook lets every routed pack through, a several-part split loses no part and reads empty has/lacks lines as empty, an end-to-end route test runs the lookup eval questions, tools.md names the route-by-verdict scenario; kb_mcp parses SSE replies holding U+2028, U+2029 and U+0085, kb_http reads a chunked POST, a small-root server answers its own question good, and the raw-read hint ignores sed -i -n
